According to initial reports, hackers compromised a Binance engineer's laptop, gaining access to internal systems used to authorize withdrawals.

The attackers then:

1. Hijacked a Binance hot wallet using Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism 

2. Redirected wallet transactions to a malicious smart contract

3. Transferred billions in crypto attacker-controlled wallets

4. Spread the stolen funds across multiple wallets and converted some assets into ETH to avoid freezes

The attack unfolded across multiple blockchains, with most funds drained in ~20 minutes.

~$3 billion of these funds have now been frozen, and Binance says it will cover all unrecovered hacking losses.

The full investigation remains ongoing.

Commercial and industrial loans at the 25 largest US banks grew almost 10% from a year ago, the fastest since early 2024. The driver is the AI data-center build-out. Bank executives are openly warning about the "long tentacles" of data-center financing risk.

A lending boom the lenders themselves are uneasy about is a late-cycle tell. The money is chasing one theme, and the banks are hedging while they feed it. Credit cracks before the stock does.

Consumer Staples, Dividend Aristocrats, and Low Volatility all gained 7% to 8.5% this month. Pure Growth, Momentum, and High Beta all fell 5% to 6.5%. That is a clean rotation out of risk and into safety.

When defensives beat growth by 13 points in a single month, money is buying insurance. The crowd that chased momentum all year is reaching for staples and dividends. That shift shows up before the headline does.

Brent crude is pushing $115 a barrel while China's oil imports are rolling over.

The most-active Brent contract has climbed from $60 in January to the $110s, near the highs of the year. At the same time China's monthly crude imports have slipped from 11 to 12 million barrels a day toward 8 million.

Price is rising while the biggest buyer pulls back. That gap is supply, not demand. Someone is choking the barrels off the water, and a crude spike into a slowing economy is a tax on every driver and shipper. This is a price shock, not inflation.
